cross_cutting: WorldData native facts, legacy research reference, historical VAE report, human anecdote and model hypothesis remain separate evidence kinds.
Player/Team per-field recency can diverge. A BIC snapshot must show mixed provenance and not silently assert fresh batch consistency.
Knowledge evidence maturity and Native action authority are separate gates.
Each missing real dataset or mechanism only blocks that claim, not unrelated read-only investigations.
Stage02 evidence evaluation is not Stage02 formal acceptance or a new authorization to modify NBA2K22.
